content_fields.title: Test that only trusted users can control the Docker daemon (Docker)
content_fields.description: Verify that only trusted users can control the Docker daemon.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means enumerating the members of the docker group and the owners of the daemon socket, and confirming each is an approved operator.
content_fields.found: Group membership is not represented in the repository.
content_fields.missing: Host account data needed for the enumeration.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification is a host account review.
content_fields.action: The platform team should enumerate and attest daemon access on each host.
